ios.desc:
Take control of your iPhone camera, without getting in its way.

Lumina puts exposure, focus, white balance and image processing in your hands. Its interface is built around the frame, keeping the image at the center of the shooting experience.

Shoot RAW, ProRAW and 48MP photos with the controls you need, without unnecessary complexity.

MANUAL CONTROLS

Set ISO and shutter speed yourself, focus by hand and adjust white balance when automatic settings are not what you want.

RAW, ProRAW AND 48MP

Choose the format that fits the shot.

Capture RAW or ProRAW when you want more room for editing, or shoot at 48MP on supported iPhones when resolution matters.

CONTROL THE PROCESSING

iPhone cameras normally make a lot of decisions after you press the shutter.

Lumina lets you reduce some of that automatic processing when you want a more natural image and more control over the final result.

FOCUS YOUR WAY

Switch to manual focus whenever autofocus is not enough.

Focus peaking helps you see which areas are in focus while composing the shot, making precise adjustments easier.

BRACKETING

Capture a sequence of exposures around your chosen settings.

Useful for difficult lighting, exposure blending and HDR workflows, without giving up manual control over the shot.

HISTOGRAM

Check luminance and RGB information while composing.

The live histogram gives you another way to judge exposure before pressing the shutter.

MACRO

On supported iPhones, Lumina gives you direct access to macro shooting while keeping the same camera controls available.

Lumina is designed to stay out of the way while you shoot. Use automatic settings when they work, take manual control when they don't, and keep your attention on the frame.

Professional controls. Made simple.

quotes.text:
Do you know Lumina [1]? It has a setting that turns off most post-processing, resulting in very natural-looking pictures. It has more features than I need, and it's free.
